title: UPaint
description: Quickly change or draw on your skin, easily with build-in simple 'editor'!
body:
This mod allows you to edit, create, and load skins for your character directly while playing Minecraft. Now you can draw and customize your skin without ever leaving a world using a convenient, built-in interface! 

**Key Features:**
* **Built-in Editor:** Features a full color palette and a set of tools, including a brush, bucket fill, an eraser(for the 2nd layer of the skin), and more.
* **Quick Access:** Open the painting window directly from your inventory using the new "P" (Paint) button.
* **Save & Load:** Save and load your skins to/from a `skins` folder inside your `.minecraft` directory under custom names, without ever leaving the game.
* **Instant Updates:** Instantly display your newly painted skin on your character in the Minecraft world.
* **Undo/Redo:** Use Ctrl+Z for Undo and Ctrl+Shift+Z for Redo.

**Basically you:**
1. Open your inventory.
2. Click the "P" button located next to your character preview.
3. Use the color palette and tools to paint your skin.
4. Click "Back", and you're done!

**Important notes:**
* To display your custom skin on a server, this mod **MUST** be installed on the server as well. Otherwise, the changes will be client-side, meaning nobody will see your new skin except you.
* This mod will not work on TLauncher because their mod `tl skin cape` overrides vanilla skin mechanics, breaking skin mods. Use legacy launcher, prism launcher or vanilla minecraft launcher to avoid issues.
